verdict.rationale: The docs imply Knowledge runs inside your own Mastra deployment. Data goes to your configured storage provider as `mastra_knowledge_*` tables, your server passes the scopes, and you view it locally via `mastra dev` and Studio. However, nothing explicitly documents self-hosting, a production deployment path or licensing. missing for 10: explicit self-hosting documentation, open-source license or source availability, production deployment guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Knowledge is stored in your configured storage provider, which adds its own `mastra_knowledge_*` tables the first time Knowledge is used
To see the page, run `mastra dev`, open Studio and select **Knowledge**.
the scopes your server passes for a run decide which ones it can read
